clause_text: Monthly rent of ₹32,000 payable on or before the 5th day of each month
Monthly rent shall remain fixed throughout the initial tenancy period
Tenant must pay rent within five days of the due date
Landlord may increase rent by 10 percent after every six months
Landlord may increase rent by 20 percent at any time without notice
Rent shall be paid through bank transfer to the landlord's nominated account
Late rent payment shall attract a reasonable penalty of ₹200 per day
Landlord may impose any additional rent amount without tenant approval
Rent shall be revised only through mutual written agreement
Tenant must pay rent even if the property becomes uninhabitable due to landlord negligence
Tenant shall pay a refundable security deposit of ₹1,28,000
Security deposit shall be refunded within 15 days after vacant possession is returned
Landlord may deduct documented repair costs from the security deposit
Landlord may retain the entire security deposit without providing reasons
Security deposit shall not carry interest during the tenancy
Landlord may deduct any amount considered appropriate from the deposit
Security deposit shall be refunded after adjustment of outstanding rent and utility bills
Tenant shall pay a security deposit equivalent to ten months of rent
Landlord may forfeit the entire deposit for any minor breach of agreement
Security deposit deductions must be supported by invoices or written evidence
Both parties agree to a mandatory lock-in period of three months
Tenant agrees to a mandatory lock-in period of 12 months without an early exit option
Neither party may terminate during lock-in except by mutual written consent or as permitted by law
Landlord may extend the lock-in period unilaterally
Tenant may terminate during lock-in by paying one month's rent as agreed compensation
Lock-in period shall automatically restart whenever rent is revised
Tenant may terminate the agreement after lock-in by providing 30 days written notice
Tenant must pay rent for the entire remaining tenancy even after the landlord breaches the agreement
Lock-in conditions may be changed only through mutual written agreement
Tenant cannot leave the property under any circumstances during the lock-in period
Either party may terminate after the lock-in period with 30 days written notice
Tenant must provide 90 days written notice before vacating the property
Landlord may terminate the tenancy immediately without providing notice or explanation
Tenant must pay three months of rent if notice is shorter than the agreed period
Landlord and tenant shall provide equal notice before ordinary termination
Landlord may waive the notice period at its sole discretion
Tenant may terminate immediately if the property becomes unsafe or legally uninhabitable
Tenant must continue paying rent for six months after submitting termination notice
Notice of termination must be provided in writing through agreed communication channels
Landlord may reject any termination notice without giving a reason
Landlord shall complete major structural repairs at its own expense
Tenant shall be responsible for routine cleaning and household upkeep
Tenant shall be responsible for all structural repairs irrespective of cause
Tenant must pay for damage directly caused by negligent use of the premises
Landlord may refuse to repair major plumbing and electrical failures
Tenant shall bear the cost of ordinary wear and tear
Landlord shall maintain the building structure and essential facilities
Tenant must repair damage caused by natural disasters and ageing infrastructure
All repair expenses shall be determined exclusively by the landlord
Landlord and tenant shall notify each other promptly about necessary repairs
Tenant shall pay electricity and water charges based on actual consumption
Tenant must pay electricity, water, gas, property tax and building insurance
Landlord may impose unlimited additional utility charges without providing bills
Tenant shall pay individually metered electricity and gas consumption charges
Tenant shall pay monthly maintenance charges as specified in the agreement
Landlord may change utility charges without informing the tenant
Tenant shall not be responsible for the landlord's personal expenses
Tenant must pay all building expenses demanded by the landlord
Utility payments shall be supported by original bills or statements
Landlord may disconnect essential utilities for delayed rent payment without following applicable law
Landlord must provide at least 48 hours prior written notice before routine inspection
Landlord may enter the property at any time without informing the tenant
Landlord may enter without notice whenever the landlord wishes
Landlord may enter immediately in a genuine emergency to prevent serious damage or danger
Landlord must obtain tenant consent before conducting non-emergency inspections
Landlord may inspect the property every week without tenant approval
Landlord shall respect tenant privacy and peaceful possession
Landlord may install surveillance devices inside the rented premises without consent
Inspection shall take place at a mutually agreed reasonable time
Landlord may enter the property whenever the tenant is absent
Tenant shall not sublet the property without prior written permission
Tenant may allow immediate family members to reside in the property
Tenant may transfer possession to another person without informing the landlord
Tenant must obtain written consent before assigning the tenancy
Landlord may prohibit all visitors from entering the premises
Tenant shall use the property exclusively for residential purposes
Tenant may accommodate guests for reasonable temporary stays
Tenant shall not permit any other person to occupy the premises under any circumstances
Tenant may sublet the property without restrictions or approval
Landlord may terminate the tenancy if the tenant hosts any visitor
Tenant shall provide valid government-issued identity documents for police verification
Tenant must provide updated address and contact details to the landlord
Landlord may retain tenant identity documents indefinitely
Tenant must cooperate with lawful police verification procedures
Landlord may disclose tenant identity documents publicly without consent
Both parties shall complete stamp duty and registration as required by applicable law
Tenant shall bear all registration costs regardless of any prior agreement
Landlord refuses to cooperate with legally required registration
Registration expenses shall be shared equally by both parties
Landlord may cancel the agreement without refunding any registration expenses
Disputes shall first be resolved through mutual discussion and good-faith negotiation
All disputes shall be decided exclusively by the landlord
Disputes shall be referred to a mutually agreed independent mediator
Landlord may select any court in India regardless of the property's location
Tenant shall have no right to challenge any decision made by the landlord
Any modification to this agreement must be recorded in writing and signed by both parties
Landlord may modify any provision of this agreement verbally
Landlord may change the agreement terms without tenant consent
Both parties acknowledge that they have read and understood the agreement
Landlord shall provide vacant and peaceful possession on the commencement date
Landlord may delay possession indefinitely without compensation or explanation
Tenant shall inspect the premises and record existing damage before taking possession
Landlord shall provide keys, access cards and agreed fixtures at handover
Tenant must accept possession even if essential facilities are unavailable
